subject.why: The tiara is immediately recognisable with its curved silver frame, teardrop and round pink accents, and central heart-shaped pink gem.

category.why: The tiara floats at a three-quarter angle in mid-air against a saturated red-orange gradient background with centred radiating sunburst rays.

clean.why: There are no text, UI elements, borders, watermarks, or characters present.

framing.why: The tiara is well-centred with ample breathing room and margins along all four edges.

colour.why: The palette is warm, bright, and vibrant, providing strong contrast between the cool silver/pink tiara and the vivid red-orange background.

detail.why: The object is rendered with clean, chunky forms and avoids busy micro-textures, scratches, or excessive decorative clutter.

style.why: It features smooth 3D volumes, soft highlights, a gentle satin finish, and clean edge definition consistent with the reference cards.
